title: Vehicle Insight — Checking your own car (15s vertical social ad)
background: Cosy UK living room, evening; car visible through the window on the drive. Warm domestic grade with brand-green UI accents (#33B87A).

characters.description: British woman, 40s, on the sofa with a cup of tea, relaxed, phone in hand
Her partner, off-screen voice from the kitchen

scenes.camera: Static cosy wide, then quick whip to her face
scenes.action: Caption: 'Quick — when's your MOT due?' She freezes mid-sip. Caption beat: '…exactly.'

dialogue.speaker: partner
dialogue.line: Wasn't the MOT due this month?

scenes.audio: Record-scratch beat of silence, soft comedy sting (volume: low)

scenes.camera: Phone macro, smooth UI glide across a dashboard
scenes.action: Vehicle Insight owner dashboard for reg LM21 KVD flips in tile by tile: 'MOT: Valid ✓ expires 10 Jul', 'Tax: due 1 Sep — we'll remind you', 'Recalls: 1 open ⚠ free fix at your dealer', 'Reliability: 82/100'.
scenes.audio: Gentle flip whooshes, calm lo-fi beat (volume: medium)

scenes.camera: Slow push on phone, valuation number counts up
scenes.action: Valuation reveals: £11,555 private sale estimate, with a green '▲ up £340 this month' pill. She smiles, relieved.

Vehicle Insight logo, headline 'Your car. Fully briefed.', CTA 'Check your car free →' with soft double-bounce, 'No card needed · Official DVLA + DVSA data', 4.8-star rating, partner wordmarks: The Telegraph, What Car?, Halfords, Select Car Leasing, Asda.
scenes.audio: Warm resolving chord. VO, female, reassuring: "MOT, tax, recalls and what it's worth — all in one place. Vehicle Insight."

style: Warm realistic domestic scenes with crisp UI motion-graphics, Fraunces + Inter Tight type, 1080x1920 vertical
